reason: I'd sign up for the free plan some night after answering emails, but I'm not paying 99 a month until I see it actually take customer emails and posts off my plate without me redoing them. At my income that's real money, and 'AI co-workers' sounds great on a page.
objection: I don't know what 100 credits actually gets me, and I'm afraid I'll spend more hours setting it up and fixing its mistakes than it saves me.
would_change_my_mind: The free co-worker handling a week of my real customer emails and social posts well enough that I only have to approve them, like my Friday invoices.
